opportunities.name: Runic Blade crit weave
opportunities.objective: Test runic blade crit weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Runic Blade charges are spent on real attacks and R boosts total AD for fifteen seconds; Essence Reaver adds a separate physical Spellblade packet after a cast. Crit strengthens ordinary attacks, while Shojin preserves basic spell access; Q remains a physical spell rather than a crit attack.
opportunities.requiredState: Spend charges between Q recasts instead of dumping all spells first.
opportunities.failure: Attack exposure and low durability lose the normal mobile trade.
opportunities.test: Compare three charge attacks plus Q against Q-only burst.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Crit does not multiply Broken Wings or the whole Runic Blade packet without a classification test.

opportunities.name: Bloodmail shield endurance
opportunities.objective: Test bloodmail shield endurance against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Valor's shield has a 1.1 AD[source modifier] term; Bloodmail supplies AD from item health, while Visage increases received shields and Sundered Sky rewards an attack between Q recasts. R's AD amplification can improve both offensive spells and shield potential within its fifteen seconds.
opportunities.requiredState: Repeatedly use E before retaliation and spend passive charges.
opportunities.failure: Healing reduction and burst arriving after the 1.5-second shield defeat the sustain.
opportunities.test: Record E shield and damage at identical missing health before and during R.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Health does not directly scale Valor; the proposed link is Bloodmail's AD conversion.

ruledOut.reason: Crit does not multiply Broken Wings or the whole Runic Blade packet without a classification test.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Runic Blade crit weave
builds.summary: Test runic blade crit weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test runic blade crit weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Runic Blade charges are spent on real attacks and R boosts total AD for fifteen seconds; Essence Reaver adds a separate physical Spellblade packet after a cast. Crit strengthens ordinary attacks, while Shojin preserves basic spell access; Q remains a physical spell rather than a crit attack.
testPlan: Required state: Spend charges between Q recasts instead of dumping all spells first.
Compare three charge attacks plus Q against Q-only burst.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attack exposure and low durability lose the normal mobile trade.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Crit does not multiply Broken Wings or the whole Runic Blade packet without a classification test.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Essence Reaver, Infinity Edge, Bloodthirster, Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Riven dashes forward, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect:

Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Riven quickly dashes and gains [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (1.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for 1.5 seconds.
Using an Ability grants Riven a charge for 6 seconds (max [3]). Her Attacks spend a charge to deal an additional [(characterLevelInterpolation(0.3 → 0.45; raw flags preserved)) × AD] physical damage.

Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her [(0.2) × AD] Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for [15] seconds. While active, she can Recast.

Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.55) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [300 / 450 / 600 + (1.65) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, based on their missing Health.
